item.title: Fixture kit: list rows aliased by position
item.body:
Closes #510
Claim: mac/m2-lead
Refs #475

### Problem
List rows of captured pages carried live row data; fixtures should stay stable and carry no live data.

### Cause
The kit aliased members and links but not the rows of list pages.

### Change
- Kit: a list page is aliased whole, by position, plus an independent check of the result and of member positions.
- Re-captured (GET only): R10, R73a, R73b. R08-2 re-captured too.
- P03c, P03f, P03g, P03i, P03k and R121e: a mechanical kit pass on the published pages, not a hand edit; oracles recomputed by the legacy parser.
- R122b removed (page, meta, oracle, map entry): R33b covers the state. #475's list of oracles goes from 9 to 8.
- Parser tests that read these rows adapted to the aliased values.

### Tests
- 39 new kit tests (one per position, rewritten rows, verifier, whole-page aliasing); tooling suite 272 OK.
- `check --corpus` 409/409 clean; independent check passed.
- `swift test` green (374 tests).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
